parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering 1 Wood for 1 Wheat. Looking at my current resources, I have 1 Wood, 2 Sheep, and 1 Wheat. My goal is to build a settlement at Node 33 (Wheat 6, Wheat 9) or Node 34 (Wheat 6, Ore 3). To build a settlement, I need 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. If I accept this trade, I will have 2 Wood and 0 Wheat. This would prevent me from building a settlement even if I were to acquire the necessary Brick. Furthermore, Claude is a competitor who I recently blocked and stole from; he likely needs the Wheat for his own expansion or a city. Giving him Wheat while leaving myself with none is strategically poor. I will reject the trade to keep my Wheat for my own future settlement.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Claude's Wood-for-Wheat trade. I need to keep my Wheat to build on Node 33 once I get Brick. Claude has plenty of Wood and Ore, but is short on Wheat.
parsed.say_outloud: קלוד, תודה על ההצעה, אבל החיטה הזאת חשובה לי מדי כרגע. אני אשמור אותה.
